root_cause.text: The amdxdna_ubuf_map() function lacks proper error handling to free allocated memory (sg table and sg structure) when sg_alloc_table_from_pages() or dma_map_sgtable() operations fail, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds error handling labels (err_free_table and err_free_sg) that were missing in the original code. The original implementation returned ERR_PTR(ret) directly on failure at two points without freeing the previously allocated sg structure and sg table, whereas the fixed version uses goto statements to ensure sg_free_table(sg) and kfree(sg) are called before returning the error pointer.

The original implementation returned ERR_PTR(ret) directly on failure at two points without freeing the previously allocated sg structure and sg table, whereas the fixed version uses goto statements to ensure sg_free_table(sg) and kfree(sg) are called before returning the error pointer.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix memory leaks in error paths by adding proper cleanup code that frees allocated sg_table and sg structures before returning errors.
intent_record.what: Replaced two direct `return ERR_PTR(ret)` statements with `goto` labels that jump to a new error handling section at the end of the function. Added cleanup code that calls `sg_free_table(sg)` and `kfree(sg)` before returning the error pointer.
intent_record.how: This change ensures proper resource cleanup on error paths. Previously, if `sg_alloc_table_from_pages()` failed, the allocated `sg` structure was leaked. If `dma_map_sgtable()` failed, the allocated table was leaked. Now both error paths properly free the sg_table and the sg structure itself before returning the error.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the vulnerability root cause by adding proper error handling and cleanup code to free allocated sg_table and sg structures in error paths of the amdxdna_ubuf_map() function, preventing the memory leak described in the vulnerability.

candidates.rationale: Line 37: Returns error without freeing the sg_table allocated by sg_alloc_table_from_pages() on line 34-35, causing memory leak when sg_alloc_table_from_pages() fails.
Line 42: Returns error without freeing the sg_table and sg structure when dma_map_sgtable() fails, causing memory leak of previously allocated resources.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement at line 37 returns an error without freeing the sg_table that was allocated by sg_alloc_table_from_pages() on lines 34-35. When sg_alloc_table_from_pages() fails, the function returns immediately without cleanup, causing a memory leak of the allocated sg_table structure.

This statement at line 42 returns an error without freeing both the sg_table and sg structure when dma_map_sgtable() fails. The sg_table was previously allocated and the sg structure was created, but neither is freed before returning the error, causing a memory leak of both resources.

    accel/amdxdna: Support user space allocated buffer
    
    Enhance DRM_IOCTL_AMDXDNA_CREATE_BO to accept user space allocated
    buffer pointer. The buffer pages will be pinned in memory. Unless

bic_trace_step.reason: The amdxdna_ubuf_map() function (lines 23-43) has a memory leak vulnerability. When sg_alloc_table_from_pages() fails at line 32-34, the function returns ERR_PTR(ret) without freeing the allocated 'sg' structure (allocated at line 29). Similarly, when dma_map_sgtable() fails at line 37-39, the function returns ERR_PTR(ret) without freeing the sg_table that was allocated and populated by sg_alloc_table_from_pages(). The corresponding amdxdna_ubuf_unmap() function (lines 45-56) properly frees these resources, but the error paths in amdxdna_ubuf_map() do not. The fix would require calling sg_free_table(sg) and kfree(sg) before returning the error pointer in both failure cases.
